call_points.text: July was the best of the four months this year and volume picked up after the MIP, but management declined to quantify it.
Cash stands at ₹2,636 Cr; any large deployment or return to shareholders is for the Board to decide.
Capital outlay remains in the ₹125-200 Cr range, with capacity added through debottlenecking rather than a large greenfield or brownfield project.
VCM availability remains limited by Middle East force majeure and logistics; the Ratnagiri jetty cannot import VCM during the four monsoon months.
Management declined to give month-wise volume figures for April-June, saying the data was not immediately available.
Management expects full-year EBITDA margins to moderate to sub-15% levels due to dynamic market conditions.
Agri demand was subdued in April due to falling prices after a March spike, but May showed some recovery ahead of monsoons.
Total capacity stands at 520,000 tons, providing sufficient headroom for growth alongside routine maintenance capex.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Dept appeal against approved TRAN-1 credit of ₹35.91L.The Department has accepted the reversal of tax and is not disputing the payment of tax in this matter.The Department contends that FIL is required to pay interest on the entire amount of excess ITC reversed, rather than only on the portion exceeding 110% of the ITC reflected in GSTR-2A for the period from February 2020 to September 2020.The Department contends that, even if the matter is considered under section 73, the penalty prescribed under that section remains applicable.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: CGST DEPT Gujarat
tax_litigation.status: FIL had already reversed the tax liability in its GSTR-3B return for December 2020. Accordingly, no tax liability remains outstanding.FIL paid interest through Form DRC-03 dated 12 March 2021 on the excess input tax credit availed over and above 110% of the ITC reflected in GSTR-2A for the period from February 2020 to September 2020.FIL had reversed the ITC before the issuance of the show cause notice. Accordingly, no penalty is leviable under section 73 in the present case. The Appeal is filed GSTAT and pending for further hearings.

timeline.summary: Orbit Electricals Private Ltd, as promoter, declared no encumbrance on Finolex Industries’ shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Reg 31(4) on 3rd April 2026.
CRISIL reaffirmed Finolex Industries' long-term rating at CRISIL AA+/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A1+ for bank facilities aggregating ₹1,916.25 Cr.
Finolex Industries Limited schedules Q4FY26 results conference call on May 27, 2026, at 16:00 IST with Managing Director Udipt Agarwal and CFO Chandan Verma.
Orbit Electricals Private Limited, acting with promoters, declared no encumbrance on Finolex Industries equity shares for FY2026, signed by Meena D’Sa on 3rd April 2026.
Finolex Industries reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,314 Cr and EBITDA of ₹332 Cr, supported by improved realizations.
Finolex Industries Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 FY26 financial results conference call on its website on May 27, 2026.
Finolex Industries reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,314 Cr and EBITDA of ₹332 Cr during the earnings call on May 27, 2026.
On its 7 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Finolex reported a 27% YoY volume fall to about 68,000 MT and 15% lower revenue of ₹884 Cr, while EBITDA rose 14% to ₹107 Cr and margin improved to 12%.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,093.96 Cr (+27.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹115.02 Cr.
Finolex Industries reported Q2FY27 standalone revenue of ₹1,094 Cr; supported by a 28% increase in sales volumes.
